stemMarkdown: Find the highest power of $2$ that divides $50!$.
solutionMarkdown: By Legendre's formula, add the floors of $50$ divided by successive powers of $2$: \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{2} \right\rfloor = 25 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{4} \right\rfloor = 12 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{8} \right\rfloor = 6 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{16} \right\rfloor = 3 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{32} \right\rfloor = 1. The total is $47$.
